description: Find people by name, title, company, school or place. With `source=public` (the default), LinkedIn's own people search: it finds people well by name, but hides many other results as "LinkedIn Member", and those are left out. With `source=sales_navigator`, Sales Navigator's lead search: every match, with each person's current roles, at a higher price. 10 a page, or 25 with Sales Navigator. A page takes about 3 seconds, or about 5 with Sales Navigator, and now and then up to 25. Give at least one of `query`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `title`, `current_company`, `past_company`, `school` or `location`. Use linkedin/profile on a result for the whole profile. Costs 7 credits (170 for `source=sales_navigator`), cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

current_company.description: Where they work now: a company page URL or `company_id`. Several, comma-separated.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

first_name.description: Their first name, as their profile gives it.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

last_name.description: Their last name, as their profile gives it.

query.description: Words to search for, as in LinkedIn's search box.

school.description: Where they studied: a school page URL or its id. Several, comma-separated.

source.description: `public` is LinkedIn's people search; `sales_navigator` is Sales Navigator's lead search, which hides no one and gives current roles, at a higher price.

title.description: Words in their current title, e.g. "head of data".

name: search_linkedin_people
title: Search people on LinkedIn
